"''We are protected by New Republic decree—|Silvo and the captain|}} A [[human]] '''merchant''' [[captain]] served onboard a [[starship]] during the [[New Republic Era]]. After the captain was interrogated by [[Jod Na Nawood|Silvo]] after a [[Silvo's pirate raid|raid]] on the ship, Silvo ordered for the human to be tossed out the [[airlock]] of the ship, which the [[Shistavanen]] [[Brutus]] followed. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== This individual, only identified as "Merchant Captain" in the credits, first appeared in the [[This Could Be a Real Adventure|first episode]] of the [[Disney+]] live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', which aired on [[December 2]], [[2024]].{{SW|url=news/skeleton-crew-premiere-date|text=''Star Wars: Skeleton Crew'' Will Debut Early|date=2024-11-26}} The character was portrayed by [[Geoffrey Lower]]. ==Appearances== *{{SkeletonCrew|This Could Be a Real Adventure}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Capitaine marchand non-identifié |ka=უცნობი ვაჭარი კაპიტანი }} [[Category:Captains]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Merchants]]
